::: {#def-dyad .theorem}
## Dyad

In a bipartite graph generator $\boldsymbol{\psi}_k$ with persons $\mathcal{P}$ and places $\mathcal{Q}$, the dyad of a person $i\in\mathcal{P}$ and a place $l\in\mathcal{Q}$ is their relational variable, taken as a single variable:

$$
D_{k,il}=\psi_k(i,l)=\psi_k(l,i),\qquad i\in\mathcal{P},\ l\in\mathcal{Q}.
$$

A person’s row $\boldsymbol{\Psi}_{ki}$ is the collection of their dyads, $(D_{k,il})_{l\in\mathcal{Q}}$.
:::
